$comment: Concept nodes for the knowledge graph (P2.1). Each is a short, neutral definition plus explicit, typed edges to EXISTING pages, verses, topics and demos — chosen by a person, checked by the build (every target id must exist in the search index). No inferred or generated relations live here. Relations: explains, appliesTo, preparesFor, relatedTo, questionTests. See docs/KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH.md.

concepts.label: Karma yoga
concepts.definition: The discipline of acting fully while giving up attachment to the results of action — the Bhagavad Gita's central teaching on work, developed across chapters 2 to 5.

concepts.label: Equanimity (samatva)
concepts.definition: Evenness of mind in gain and loss, praise and blame — which the Bhagavad Gita calls yoga itself (2.48).

concepts.label: Advaita Vedanta
concepts.definition: The non-dual school of Vedanta, most associated with Adi Shankaracharya, which holds that the Self and ultimate reality are one.

concepts.label: The Divine Mother (Devi)
concepts.definition: Hymns and praises addressed to the Goddess — as Lalitha, Durga, Sri (Lakshmi) and Abhirami — across Sanskrit and Tamil devotion.

concepts.label: Data skew
concepts.definition: When a few keys or partitions hold far more data than the rest, so one task or node does most of the work — the most common reason a distributed job is slow.

concepts.label: SQL window functions
concepts.definition: SQL functions that compute across a set of rows related to the current row — rankings, running totals, lags — without collapsing them the way GROUP BY does.

concepts.label: Data modeling
concepts.definition: Designing the tables, keys and grain that turn business events into data you can trust and query — the heart of most data-engineering design interviews.

concepts.label: Data system design interviews
concepts.definition: The interview round where you design a data platform end to end — ingestion, storage, processing, serving — and defend the trade-offs.

concepts.label: Master data management
concepts.definition: Keeping one trusted record for each customer, product or supplier across many systems — matching, merging and governing it.

concepts.label: Job search in 2026
concepts.definition: Finding roles that are real and still open, and getting from an application to a conversation with a person.

concepts.label: Personal data exposure
concepts.definition: Where personal information ends up online — data brokers, trackers, social traces — and what can be done to reduce it.

concepts.label: Enterprise AI adoption
concepts.definition: What it takes for AI to deliver value inside an organisation — cost, governance, risk and the operating model around the agents.
